user.title: Sources

data_description.name: Name of this planner; the sensors are named after it.
data_description.room_temp_entity: Sensor the thermal model predicts (one representative room). Needs long-term statistics.
data_description.outdoor_temp_entity: Outdoor sensor the model was fitted on (history for the state estimate).
data_description.weather_entity: Weather entity with an hourly forecast (outdoor temperature ahead).
data_description.forecast_bias: Forecast minus outdoor sensor, one value or 24 comma separated values (00..23 h). Subtracted from the forecast.
data_description.heat_output_entity: Heat output power (W or kW). Strongly recommended: without it the state estimate cannot see past heating.
data_description.heating_active_entity: Optional: heat output counts as space heating only where this sensor is above 0 (e.g. desired flow temperature), the rest is hot water.

user.description: Heat Planner computes a plan only; it never controls a device. Pick the sensors of your house.

energy.title: Energy

data_description.import_energy_entity: Energy counter of grid import (household load profile).
data_description.heat_pump_energy_entity: Electricity counter of the heat pump; subtracted from the household load.
data_description.battery_charge_energy_entity: Energy counter of the energy charged into the battery (AC side, kWh or Wh). Subtracted from the household load; also used for today's accounting.
data_description.battery_discharge_energy_entity: Energy counter of the energy discharged from the battery (AC side, kWh or Wh). Added back to the household load; also used for today's accounting.
data_description.pv_power_entity: Solar power (W or kW), history for the solar gains.
data_description.pv_forecast_entities: Forecast sensors with a detailedForecast attribute (Solcast: today and tomorrow).

energy.description: Counters for the household load profile and the PV forecast.

data_description.price_source: Where the known future prices come from.
data_description.price_entity: Current all-in price sensor (its statistics give the expected prices beyond the known ones; with the attributes source also the price list).
data_description.price_breakdown_entity: Optional: all-in price with an energy_price attribute (spot price excl. VAT, same unit); gives the taxes per kWh live.
data_description.peak_entity: Optional: entity with a periods attribute [{start, end}]. Without it (and beyond its periods) the most expensive share of each day counts as peak.
data_description.net_metering: Export is netted against import (export price = import price - fee).
data_description.net_metering_entity: Optional on/off entity that overrides the net metering option.
data_description.export_price_entity: Optional: export price with net metering; the fee is then computed live (price sensor - this).
data_description.price_forecast_entity: Optional: spot price series with raw_today/raw_tomorrow/raw_forecast attributes (e.g. Energy Price Forecast EU, base price). Used for hours without a known price, converted to an all-in price as spot x (1 + VAT) + fixed part; the fixed part is learned from the hours where both are known. Without it the same-hour median of the last days is used.

devices.title: Battery and hot water

data_description.plan_battery: Optimise heat pump and home battery together (still read-only).
data_description.dhw_mode: Plan the hot water tank, use an external schedule, or ignore hot water.
data_description.dhw_tank_temp_entity: Detects whether the tank was already charged today.
data_description.legionella_entity: On while a legionella cycle runs: the heat pump counts as busy, nothing is planned then.

energy.description: Counters for the household load profile and the PV forecast.

data_description.price_source: Where the known future prices come from.
data_description.price_entity: Current all-in price sensor (its statistics give the expected prices beyond the known ones; with the attributes source also the price list).
data_description.price_breakdown_entity: Optional: all-in price with an energy_price attribute (spot price excl. VAT, same unit); gives the taxes per kWh live.
data_description.avoid_peaks: No heating and no hot water during peak price periods.
data_description.peak_entity: Optional: entity with a periods attribute [{start, end}]. Without it (and beyond its periods) the most expensive share of each day counts as peak.
data_description.peak_share: Share of the most expensive quarters per day treated as peak where no periods are known.
data_description.net_metering: Export is netted against import (export price = import price - fee).
data_description.net_metering_entity: Optional on/off entity that overrides the net metering option.
data_description.net_metering_fee: Export price below the import price with net metering (per kWh).
data_description.export_price_entity: Optional: export price with net metering; the fee is then computed live (price sensor - this).
data_description.export_fixed_costs: All-in import price minus spot price incl. VAT; used for the export price without net metering.
data_description.vat_percent: Export price without net metering = (price - taxes) / (1 + VAT) - export fee.
data_description.export_fee: Charged per exported kWh (without net metering).
data_description.price_forecast_entity: Optional: spot price series with raw_today/raw_tomorrow/raw_forecast attributes (e.g. Energy Price Forecast EU, base price). Used for hours without a known price, converted to an all-in price as spot x (1 + VAT) + fixed part; the fixed part is learned from the hours where both are known. Without it the same-hour median of the last days is used.

data_description.min_temp: The plan keeps the room above this. Higher = earlier and longer heating.
data_description.max_temp: Upper limit; a wider band stores more heat in cheap hours.
data_description.hard_min_temp: Never planned below this (very high penalty).
data_description.safety_margin: Added to the minimum far ahead (full value from 24 h, 60 % at 12 h, 40 % at 6 h).
data_description.margin_penalty: Cost per K per quarter hour that the room is predicted below minimum + safety margin (4x at the end of the horizon). Higher: heats earlier and safer; lower: saves more. Default 2.
data_description.comfort_penalty: Cost per K per quarter hour below the minimum or above the maximum temperature (10x below the hard minimum). Default 20.
data_description.start_cost: Penalty per heating block (start-up losses, wear), in your currency.
data_description.tail_hours: Hours planned after the last known price with expected prices (provisional).

building.title: Building (thermal model)

data_description.heat_loss_w_k: Room to outdoor heat loss coefficient (transmission + ventilation).
data_description.mass_capacity_kwh_k: Floors, walls, slab; the heat pump heats this node.
data_description.coupling_w_k: Heat transfer between room air and building mass.
data_description.internal_gain_fraction: Share of the household electricity (excl. heat pump) that heats the house.
data_description.solar_gain_factor: kWh heat in the house per kWh PV production.
data_description.solar_to_mass: 0 = all solar gain into the room air, 1 = all into the mass.

building.description: Two-node model: room air and building mass. Defaults describe an example house; fit them for yours (see README).

data_description.hp_max_heat_kw: Full-load heat output at and below the knee temperature.
data_description.hp_knee_temp: Above this the output drops by the slope.
data_description.cop_base: COP = base + temperature x To - load x heat output, clipped to min/max.
data_description.start_ramp: Share of the heat output in the first 15 minutes of a block.

data_description.plan_battery: Optimise heat pump and home battery together (still read-only).
data_description.battery_capacity_entity: Read the capacity live from this entity (kWh or Wh); the capacity below is the fallback.
data_description.battery_charge_power_entity: Read the max charge power live from this entity (W or kW); the charge power below is the fallback.
data_description.battery_charge_power_attribute: Leave empty to use the entity state, e.g. max_charge_power.
data_description.battery_discharge_power_entity: Read the max discharge power live from this entity (W or kW); the discharge power below is the fallback.
data_description.battery_discharge_power_attribute: Leave empty to use the entity state, e.g. max_discharge_power.
data_description.battery_min_soc_entities: Read the minimum charge live (% or kWh); the highest available value is used, the minimum charge below is the fallback. E.g. discharge limit and backup reserve.
data_description.battery_max_soc_entity: Read the maximum charge live (% or kWh); the maximum charge below is the fallback.

data_description.dhw_mode: Plan the hot water tank, use an external schedule, or ignore hot water.
data_description.dhw_tank_temp_entity: Detects whether the tank was already charged today.
data_description.legionella_entity: On while a legionella cycle runs: the heat pump counts as busy, nothing is planned then.
data_description.dhw_power_kw: Electric power while charging the tank (at the reference COP).
data_description.dhw_low_temp: The heat pump charges by itself below low - hysteresis.
